lines: reasons your weekends undo your week
cover.sub: Number 5 is the one nobody notices.

reasons.head: Your drinks make you eat more
reasons.sub: Alcohol doesn't just add calories. It also makes you eat more food at the same meal.

reasons.head: You treat Friday night as a free pass
reasons.sub: One cheat meal turns into a cheat weekend. Two days can quietly wipe out five.

reasons.head: Your routine disappears
reasons.sub: No set meal times means grazing all day, one small bite at a time.

reasons.head: You stay up late snacking
reasons.sub: Late nights mean more hours awake and more trips to the kitchen.

reasons.head: You don't see what the weekend costs
reasons.sub: In one study, dieters lost weight during the week but stopped losing on weekends.
